en_title: $150 God of War Laufey Collector Box Revealed, No Game Included
subtitle: 有雕像，没游戏
opus_summary: 索尼公布《战神：劳菲》收藏盒，附主角雕像，却不含实体或数字版游戏。收藏盒将于2027年2月16日通过PlayStation独家限量发售，10月13日开启预购。

paragraphs.en: Following in the footsteps of GTA 6, God of War Laufey is the next big game to get a collector box without the game itself.
paragraphs.cn: 继《GTA6》之后，《战神：劳菲》成为又一款推出收藏盒却不附游戏本体的大作。

paragraphs.en: Sony has revealed the collector box for God of War Laufey, which costs $150 and includes a nice statue of Faye. Unfortunately it does not include a steelbook with a disc copy of the game, or any copy of the game, physically or digitally. Preorders open today at 10am PT through PlayStation Direct, and stock is limited, Sony warned. You can view a full breakdown of the box's items below.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼公布了《战神：劳菲》收藏盒，售价150美元(约合人民币1005元)，内含一尊精美的菲雕像。遗憾的是，盒内既没有附带游戏光盘的铁盒，也不含任何实体或数字版游戏。收藏盒将于今天太平洋时间上午10点（北京时间10月14日凌晨1点）在PlayStation Direct开启预购，索尼提醒库存有限。以下是盒内物品的完整清单。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey Collector Box contents:

Predictably, a lot of people are drawing comparisons to the game-less GTA 6 collector's box . However, some may be a bit more accepting of the value God of War is offering here. GTA 6's box includes a bunch of Vice City-themed merch, such as a pair of sunglasses, a hat, and a figure of a cartoon gator named Macca. It also costs a whopping $400, which is tough to swallow.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，许多人将它与同样不含游戏的《GTA6》收藏盒作比较。不过，部分人或许会更认可这款《战神》收藏盒的性价比。《GTA6》收藏盒内含一批罪恶都市主题周边，例如一副太阳镜、一顶帽子，以及名为Macca的卡通鳄鱼手办。它的售价还高达400美元(约合人民币2680元)，实在让人难以接受。

paragraphs.en: Many were critical of the fact that GTA 6's box didn't include a statue of Jason and Lucia , in addition to feeling like the box could've been cheaper if it didn't include certain items. So, God of War Laufey may not be as egregious to some fans given it is a smaller box with a statue of the protagonist. Still, it does feel a bit lacking compared to previous God of War collector's editions.
paragraphs.cn: 许多人批评《GTA6》收藏盒没有包含杰森和露西亚的雕像，也认为如果去掉某些物品，收藏盒本可以卖得更便宜。因此，对部分粉丝而言，《战神：劳菲》收藏盒或许没那么离谱，毕竟它规模较小，而且附有主角雕像。不过，与此前的《战神》典藏版相比，它确实显得有些单薄。

paragraphs.en: God of War Ragnarok's collector's edition included Thor's hammer, a steelbook (no game disc, though), DLC, a code for PS4 and PS5 copies of the game, and a handful of other trinkets. God of War 2018's collector's edition included a statue of Kratos and Atreus, a steelbook with a disc, a physical map, a litograph, and two small figures of Brok and Sindri, in addition to a bunch of digital content.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：诸神黄昏》典藏版包含雷神之锤、铁盒（不过没有游戏光盘）、DLC、PS4和PS5版游戏的兑换码，以及其他一些小物件。2018年《战神》的典藏版则包含奎托斯与阿特柔斯的雕像、附带光盘的铁盒、实体地图、石版画，以及布罗克和辛德里的两尊小型手办，此外还有一批数字内容。

paragraphs.en: While this is likely supposed to be an add-on for people who are already planning on buying the game, it's disappointing that God of War Laufey's box doesn't at least include a complimentary upgrade to the game's digital deluxe edition, which includes special armor and weapons in the full game.
paragraphs.cn: 这款收藏盒很可能是供那些已经打算购买游戏的人额外选购的，但《战神：劳菲》收藏盒连免费升级至数字豪华版的福利都没有，仍然令人失望。数字豪华版包含可在完整游戏中使用的特殊护甲和武器。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey – Collector Box will be available in "highly limited quantities" exclusively direct from PlayStation on February 16, 2027 for a recommended retail price of $149.99 USD/ €149.99/ £129.99. Preorders begin today, October 13, 2026 at 10am local time.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》收藏盒将于2027年2月16日由PlayStation独家直售，数量「极其有限」，建议零售价为149.99美元(约合人民币1005元)／149.99欧元(约合人民币1125元)／129.99英镑(约合人民币1154元)。预购将于今天，即2026年10月13日当地时间上午10点开启。
